status: AWAITING HUMAN REVIEW: initial expert guesses, not measured values

source_cred.rationale: Most forwarded messages carry no recognisable link; trusted and low sources are each a minority.

claim_true.rationale: Trusted sources are usually right, low-credibility ones rarely; an unknown source is a coin flip before other evidence. Columns: trusted, unknown, low.

fact_check.rationale: A refuting fact-check is much more likely for false claims, a supporting one for true claims; most claims have no coverage. Columns: claim true, claim false.

corroboration.rationale: Trusted outlets report true claims more often than false ones, but absence is only weak evidence. Columns: claim true, claim false.

sensational.rationale: False claims read somewhat more alarmingly; this is a weak cue. Columns: claim true, claim false.

specifics.rationale: True claims somewhat more often carry checkable details; a weak cue. Columns: claim true, claim false.
